:::{#exm-nonconstructive-proof}
#### A non-constructive proof

Claim: among any three [integers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers),
there are two that are both [even](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-even-odd)
or both [odd](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-odd).

Proof: each [integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers) is even or odd.
If at most one of the three integers were even,
and at most one were odd,
there would be at most two integers in all.
So at least two of the three are even,
or at least two are odd.

This [proof](#def-proof) is a [non-constructive proof](#def-nonconstructive-proof),
since it does not say which two of the integers share their parity.

:::
